# Status lifecycle

Values of `status` in declaration order; transitions are declared in `archdoc.json` (they are a product decision, not derivable from code).

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  Found : Found
  Draft_CV : Draft CV
  Draft_CV_and_Cover_Letter : Draft CV & Cover Letter
  CV_Drafted : CV Drafted
  Applied : Applied
  Shortlisted : Shortlisted
  Interview : Interview
  Offer : Offer
  Pass : Pass
  Rejected : Rejected
  Expired : Expired
  [*] --> Found
  Found --> Draft_CV
  Found --> Draft_CV_and_Cover_Letter
  Draft_CV --> CV_Drafted
  Draft_CV_and_Cover_Letter --> CV_Drafted
  CV_Drafted --> Applied
  Applied --> Shortlisted
  Shortlisted --> Interview
  Interview --> Offer
  state "any active status" as any_active
  any_active --> Pass
  any_active --> Rejected
  any_active --> Expired
  Offer --> [*]
  Pass --> [*]
  Rejected --> [*]
  Expired --> [*]
```

## Notes

- **archived** — Orthogonal boolean flag, not a status: ended/closed roles are hidden from the main grid but kept (ADR-011).
- **Pass / Rejected / Expired** — Terminal outcomes reachable from any active status.
